Seller Listing ValidatorValue per 1,000

Ten fewer reviews per 1,000 submissions

Route clear issues to the submitter

100 → 90

At 20 minutes each, ten avoided reviews free 200 minutes.

Prepare the remaining cases

20 → 15 min

If preparation saves five minutes on 90 cases, another 450 minutes become available.

At an assumed 12M eligible submissions per year, routing alone frees 40,000 hours. At $60 per hour that is $2.4M of gross capacity.

Illustrative assumptions. Validate quality, operating costs, and realizable cash savings in the pilot.04 / 05
Seller Listing ValidatorPilot decision

One category and an agreed quality bar

Start with US small appliances

Establish a baseline, run in shadow, then enable a seller cohort. Specialists adjudicate sampled clears and correction requests.

Request from the customer

A volume and handling-time baseline, an exact-SKU data owner, a reviewer lead, and numeric quality and stop thresholds.

Measure cases per 1,000, active minutes, seller wait, total cost, missed defects and incorrect corrections.

Expand when the pilot shows capacity at maintained quality.05 / 05

Presenter notes

Discovery · 3 minutes

My AWS background is why I chose Amazon. Ask where cases enter the queue and which catalog system establishes an exact-SKU fact. Validate the gap alongside Amazon’s existing seller tools.

Solution and constraints · 6 minutes

Show both OpenAI surfaces. Explain AI preparation, reviewer authority, seller edits, policy versions and revalidation. The personal ChatGPT handoff uses the verified rehearsal path. Ask which customer data may leave the case system.

Live demo · 18 minutes

0:00 headphones · 2:15 plush · 3:45 sibling escalation · 5:30 three intake paths · 7:00 ChatGPT evidence review · 10:30 authorize · 12:45 seller corrects · 14:00 silent record and trace · 16:15 pilot impact. Reserve space for questions.

Business case · first minute of close

Show the two value levers without double counting. Discuss which staffing, overtime, or contractor decision could turn freed capacity into cash. Revenue lift is a separate pilot hypothesis.

Executive ask · final two minutes

Ask for a sponsor, evidence owner, baseline and quality gates. Out of role, reserve 15 minutes for tradeoffs, stale approval, calibrated thresholds, and the five-pair API comparison.
